candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Data Engineer internship in People & Culture. You ask for SQL, Python, data modelling and real care about data accuracy, and checking whether the numbers are right is what I did every day in my previous roles.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea, including HR dashboards.

achievements.impact: I designed SAP Datasphere data pipelines and built data models from ABAP CDS view sources and joins
I used SQL analysis, validation and reconciliation to keep reporting correct, and supported around 30 dashboards across HR, finance and supply chain
I built DocuMind, a RAG application with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker

letter.problems_section: I would build and test pipelines in SQL and Python, check data quality and document my work so others can rely on it. I have not used BigQuery, Airflow or dbt yet, but moving from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere showed me I can learn a new data platform quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Berlin and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship length and hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
